body.name: Second-order pair-orbit selection handle
body.construction: Derive a local asymptotic decision experiment from the ten-type schedule simplex and kernel \(K\), retaining the joint local fluctuations of \(\tau\), pair-type counts, and observation counts on every boundary face; then take the smaller-order variational risk on the tangent cone determined by \((s_J-J/2)\) and recover exact finite minimizers from its contact set.
